Replay

Authority-only rewind history

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Introduced in content 0x5253435241503048 and retained through content 49 and later revisions, Replay keeps the 32-tick hit_history in the authority's complete World and checkpoints, while omitting it from ordinary public snapshots. The save guide records the current content and conversion contract. Current players, mobs, projectiles, health, equipment and other gameplay state remain public. The captured loaded-workload delta that motivated this change had 7,581 of its 7,861 changed bytes in this historical cache.

The model explicitly declares its public replication and prediction policies. Its prediction world contains all visible actors and uses neutral remote-player controls; remote displayed poses continue to use authoritative observations. A historical ray or mend query whose history is unavailable cannot judge a hit locally. Its beam/wall preview still appears, and the server's confirmed outcome supplies actual damage/healing. Singleplayer and the authority retain the original history and historical judgment rules. No unavailable query falls back to live geometry.

Checkpoint capture uses the complete authority projection. Host migration, saves and offline conversion therefore retain the history needed for subsequent rewind queries. Tests compare complete restored history and continue simulation. The content-48 transition changed the projection/schema contract: content-47 rooms required matching old clients, while content-48 clients used new rooms and databases. The converter paths for contents 42–48 retain those source contracts and seed the recorded takeover epoch. They verify full-world preservation and report the new public digest separately. Use the current offline conversion procedure for the complete accepted format list.

The loaded fixture checks public payload reduction and real compression support and delivery. Adaptive compression is allowed to choose sparse or ordinary LZ4 deltas when grouping would not help; it does not require a larger encoding to be selected merely to satisfy a counter. Dedicated grouping/transfer tests remain, and complete recovery archives still exercise their grouped compression path.

Cosmetic wound placement now has an explicit adapter: the authority uses its private rewind cache; clients read an exact retained public event-tick frame and verify the victim generation. That frame may be corrected or predicted, and missing history refuses placement. These coordinates do not grant hit authority or transmit the private rewind cache. The editor-first migration's revive gate exposed and verified this correction to the older presentation path.
